subject: Warm transfer: Synapse Health onboarding + SOW & kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Rivera <emily.rivera@synapsehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@synapsehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Synapse Health – contract signed, warm transfer + next steps

Team — quick context and ask. Synapse (EMR integrator for regional clinics) signed the 12-month Dedicated plan yesterday; ARR $540k.  Highlights you should know:

- Primary contact: Emily Rivera (Director of Engineering) and Michael Chen (IT Ops). Procurement looped in procurement@synapsehealth.com for PO.
- Scope: Hosted + Dedicated reserved capacity (2x A100 equivalent), embeddings for search, real-time chat for triage workflows.
- Data: They will send PHI through API; need Private deployment considerations (VPC) scoped during implementation. Short-term they accept using Dedicated with strict logging controls, long-term target is Private VPC.
- Timeline: kickoff window target: week of 5/22, go-live target: 7/15.
- Known constraints: their infra team requires an IP allowlist and SCIM SSO integration. They also requested a SOC2 audit summary and our data retention policy.

Attached: Synapse_SOW_v3.pdf (redlines included), synapse_tech_requirements.xlsx, redwood-data-processing-FAQ.pdf. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/591234567.

What I need from CS + Implementation:
1) Confirm ownership of kickoff and primary implementation lead.
2) Quick read of SOW items that might need legal/ops exceptions (I highlighted uncertain sections).
3) Pre-kickoff checklist items we want Synapse to complete before 5/22 (e.g., firewall rules, service accounts, sample payloads).

Sooj, would you own the customer relationship? Tessa, can you take implementation lead? Olga — can you be available for one technical deep-dive during kickoff (networking and SSO)? Karthik — I'll stay on as escalation and product/contract clarifier.

Emily — looping you so you can see who will be running the kickoff and to confirm the tentative dates. Please reply with any must-have constraints we should be aware of before scheduling.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Synapse_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 312KB); synapse_tech_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 88KB); redwood-data-processing-FAQ.pdf (PDF, 74KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Rivera <emily.rivera@synapsehealth.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@synapsehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synapse Health – contract signed, warm transfer + next steps

Thanks for the handoff, Jonas — congrats on closing. Quick answers and next steps: 

- I will be the CS owner. Primary CS lead: Soojin Lee.
- Implementation lead confirmed: Tessa Morgan will lead the technical implementation. Tessa — please confirm your availability for kickoff week (5/22).
- Olga can cover the SSO/network deep dive during kickoff and will review synapse_tech_requirements.xlsx for any red flags.
- Karthik, please drop any product caveats here (rate limits, batching, model variants) that may affect the implementation timeline.

Pre-kickoff checklist (draft):
- Customer to provide IP ranges for allowlist + firewall window for connectivity testing.
- Service account + identity owner for SCIM SSO test environment.
- Sample payloads for embeddings and chat flows (PII/PHI redacted).
- PO number and procurement contact for invoice creation.
- Confirmation of retention window (default 30 days) and any legal exceptions.

I'll set a 60-minute kickoff with the following agenda: intro/roles, network & security, SSO, data flow & sample payloads, success criteria & timeline. Proposed slots: Tue 5/23 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 5/24 09:00-10:00 PT. Emily — does either work for you?

Jonas — I reviewed the SOW at a high level. Section 4.3 on optional model tuning looks like it needs clarification: cost and deliverables. I'll flag it for a legal + product touchpoint.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Rivera <emily.rivera@synapsehealth.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@synapsehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synapse Health – contract signed, warm transfer + next steps

Appreciate the context. I can take kickoff and the implementation track. My availability for kickoff week: Tue 5/23 all morning PT and Wed 5/24 morning as well. I prefer Tue 5/23 10:00-11:00 PT.

Quick technical notes for the thread (Karthik / Olga please add):
- We'll need a staging environment in Dedicated for an initial ingest (~10M tokens) to validate KV cache behavior and batching profiles. Expect ~48-72 hours for a basic ingest window.
- SCIM: Synapse uses Okta. We'll want a test Okta org to validate group mappings.
- Networking: recommend 2-step testing — connectivity then TLS handshake + cert pinning verification. Provide the specific IP ranges, and we will confirm egress ports (443) + minimal CIDR blocks.
- Compliance: I'll need the SOC2 summary and any contractual retention exceptions before we enable PHI payloads. Jonas — can you confirm procurement timeline and PO ETA?

I will create a short pre-kickoff form (Google Form link to follow) that captures the items Soojin listed; would like Synapse to complete it at least 3 business days before kickoff.

Tessa Morgan
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Rivera <emily.rivera@synapsehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@synapsehealth.com>, procurement@synapsehealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synapse Health – contract signed, warm transfer + next steps

Thanks, all — locking in Tue 5/23 10:00-11:00 PT for kickoff (calendar invite sent). Emily confirmed the slot via a quick DM. 

A few quick clarifications from procurement side: Synapse expects to issue the PO by 5/19. I asked legal to review Section 4.3 and they flagged one line-item about model tuning SOW deliverables — we'll have legal + product join if needed, but won't block kickoff.

Pre-kickoff ask for Synapse (I'll send this in a separate email with links):
- IP ranges for allowlisting and an admin contact for network tests.
- Okta test org credentials (or temporary test account) for SCIM validation.
- One representative sample payload for embeddings (redacted) and one for chat flow.
- PO number or expected PO ETA.

Tessa — assigning you as Implementation Lead. Soojin — assigning you as Customer Success Lead. Olga — tech deep-dive. Karthik — product point for rate-limit/variant constraints. I'm marking myself as AE escalation.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
